model: MHW5630HW (MHW5630HC is the metallic slate colour)
notes: Maytag 4.5 cu ft, 27-inch front loader (white); the spec sheet lists a direct-drive motor and an internal heater and rates the washer 120 V on a 15 or 20 A circuit. The component values come from Whirlpool's service manual for 27-inch Whirlpool and Maytag front loaders and are given for the whole family; the manual also notes two motor sizes, one for 4.3/4.5 cu ft drums and one for 4.8/5.0 cu ft.

gaps: The manual's page text names no model numbers. The tie to MHW5630HW rests on the PDF's embedded file metadata (model numbers MHW5630HW0 and MHW5630HC0, keyword MHW5630H) and on the Maytag details that match the spec sheet (27 in wide, 4.5 cu ft, direct drive, knob console).
Years: 2018 is the year of introduction the model code key gives for the H in MHW5630H (p. 1-11); neither source gives production years.
The 120 V and 15 or 20 A on the spec sheet are for the whole washer, so no voltage or current is set on any part.
The rotor magnet material is not stated; no part numbers, chip markings or wattages for the motor, heater, pumps or valves are printed, so none are claimed.
The heater is 'on some models' in the manual; the spec sheet's internal heater is the tie for this model.
The manual's connector map also lists dry heater, blower fan and dry NTC connectors (for all-in-one models); none are claimed.
method: Whirlpool & Maytag 27-inch Front-Load Washers service manual W11169652A (Whirlpool Corporation, copyright 2019), read from an Amazon S3 copy; title, part number and copyright confirmed on the cover and forward.
The whirlpool.com copy of the same file did not open (fetch failed, then timed out), so the S3 copy was used.
Pages read: 1-11, 1-13, 2-18, 3-7, 3-10, 3-11, 3-13 to 3-17, 4-19 and 4-23; the resistance pages were rendered and read as images. The PDF's file properties were read with pdfinfo.

Maytag MHW5630H specification sheet (Maytag document D200104XXD, copyright 2020), retailer-hosted copy on static.pcrichard.com; it names MHW5630HW and MHW5630HC and lists the direct drive motor, internal heater and 10-year parts warranty.
No bot check, login or paywall met. Sears PartsDirect, PartSelect and AppliancePartsPros were not used.

comps.spec: Direct drive motor, listed in the spec sheet's features, with a 10-year limited parts warranty that covers the direct drive motor and the stainless steel wash basket.
Stator, six T-30 Torx bolts, removed after the rotor (p. 4-19). Winding check: 6-20 ohm between each pair of motor harness connector J6 pins 1-2, 2-3 and 1-3 (Test 3, p. 3-10).
Rotor, held on the drive shaft by a bolt turned with a 5/8 in hex socket; a flat screwdriver in a rotor slot blocks it while the bolt is loosened, and the rotor then pulls off backwards (p. 4-19).
Drain pump: 18.5-21.5 ohm between ACU connector J11 pins 1 and 2 (Test 8, p. 3-15).
Recirculation pump: 36-46 ohm between ACU connector J11 pins 3 and 4 (Test 8, p. 3-15).
Inlet water valves: cold 1, cold 2 and hot 1 fill valves, in single or double valve assemblies; each coil reads 1.1-1.35 kohm (Test 6, p. 3-13).

Wash heating element, 'on some models' in the manual, on the heating/temperature sensor assembly: 7-30 ohm across its two terminals and across ACU connector J3 pins 1 and 2 (Test 9, p. 3-16). Wired between the L1 and N heater relays (strip circuit, p. 3-16).
Wash temperature sensor (NTC thermistor) on the heating element assembly, +5 VDC from ACU connector J15 pin 1: 20.0 kohm at 25 C (77 F), 65.5 kohm at 0 C, 0.3 kohm at 150 C (Test 10, p. 3-17).
Water level sensor, at the top centre of the right cabinet panel, on a pressure hose from the tub's air trap; wired to ACU connector J14 with +5 VDC on pin 3 (Test 7, p. 3-14).
Door lock solenoid: 60-90 ohm with the door closed, measured at J7 pins 2 and 3 (Test 4, p. 3-11). It sits in the door lock assembly with the door switch and lock switch.
Door switch in the door lock assembly: open circuit with the door open and 60-90 ohm with it closed, measured at J7 pins 2 and 3 (Test 4, p. 3-11). The assembly also holds a lock switch.

ACU (appliance control unit) board, with connectors J3 (wash heater), J6 (motor), J7 (door lock), J8 (water valves), J11 (drain and recirculation pumps), J14 (water level sensor) and J15 (wash temperature sensor) (connector map, p. 3-7).
Suspension: the vibration and noise troubleshooting says to check spring and damper placement and installation (p. 2-18), and tub removal pulls the dampers off the tub (p. 4-23).
